title: Sony a1 II Stacked Full-Frame (ILCE-1M2)
purpose: Flagship stacked full-frame baseline for maximum sharpness hit-rate and micro-motion freeze.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35mm full-frame stacked Exmor RS BSI CMOS
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15 stops dynamic range with 16-bit processing pipeline
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic stacked shutter with 1/400s high-speed flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Flash-dominated exposure with studio strobe to freeze micro motion, 1/400s flash sync, ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Key light 35 to 45 degrees camera left and slightly above eye line, minimal fill, strong black flag negative fill on shadow side for deep micro-contrast, optional low-power rim light for edge separation

surface_rendering: Natural epidermal skin texture with resolved pores, fine vellus hair, and accurate subsurface dermal scattering
True material micro-relief: fabric weave, micro-abrasions, uncompressed specular highlight falloff
Ultra-sharp editorial clarity without artificial smoothing, no diffusion, no haze
High optical acutance without digital edge halos or unsharp masking artifacts
depth_and_optics: Focus locked on the near eye with eyelashes and iris tack sharp, absolute zero motion blur
Natural compression characteristic of 85mm portrait telephoto optics at f/5.6
Zero perspective distortion, clean rectilinear projection

execution_directive: Enforce stacked full-frame raw capture fidelity at 50.1MP. Prioritize shutter freeze (1/400s flash sync) and near-eye focus lock for maximum sharpness hit-rate.
